titre: La moitié du trafic web n'est plus humaine
sous_titre: Part du trafic web mondial générée par des robots, en %, de 2021 à 2024

series.nom: Part du trafic web venant de robots

2021.texte: 42.3% of Internet traffic in 2021 wasn't human

2022.texte: In 2022, nearly half (47.4%) of all Internet traffic came from bots

2023.texte: nearly half (49.6%) of all global internet traffic was generated by bots

2024.texte: automated traffic surpassed human activity, accounting for 51% of all web traffic in 2024
